_comment: Hand-derived expected values for KPI baseline instrumentation validation (WO-207). These values are computed by hand from the golden dataset inputs, NEVER generated by running the code under test. Each entry includes numerator, denominator and result for traceability.
_provenance: Golden dataset inputs are defined in test code as in-memory SlaAggRow / LabourWeekRow objects. Boundary cases use exact arithmetic. Segments sum to ALL rollup to verify reconciliation. Date: 2026-08-12.

sla_compliance._formula: compliance_rate = compliant_count / total_closed per segment; ALL rollup = SUM(compliant_count) / SUM(total_closed) [weighted, NOT mean of rates]
sla_compliance._denominator_exclusions: CANCELLED work orders excluded; work orders with excluded_from_sla_compliance=true excluded; null resolution_due_at treated as compliant (BR-21)
sla_compliance._deadline_rule: closed at exactly deadline (updated_at == resolution_due_at) is COMPLIANT (inclusive less-or-equal). One second after deadline is BREACHED.

dataset_C._description: All work orders have null resolution_due_at (no SLA policy) — all treated compliant

cancelled_excluded._description: CANCELLED work orders must not appear in compliance denominator

resolution_time._formula: mean = arithmetic mean of elapsed_minutes from created_at to updated_at; median = percentile_cont(0.5) — linear interpolation at 0.5 quantile for even count
resolution_time._median_rule: Even n: (sorted[n/2 - 1] + sorted[n/2]) / 2. Odd n: sorted[n/2]. Matches PostgreSQL percentile_cont(0.5) definition.

dataset_A._description: P1 ten values, P2 six values — both even count for median boundary coverage

P3._derivation: sum=750, mean=187.5; even n=4: (sorted[1]+sorted[2])/2 = (90+135)/2 = 112.5 — mean ≠ median, proving distribution-based computation

technician_utilization._formula: team_rate = SUM(all logged_field_minutes) / SUM(all shift_minutes) — sum-of-numerators, NOT mean-of-ratios
technician_utilization._zero_logged_time_rule: A technician who logged zero field minutes has incompleteData=true when no shift minutes exist; rate=0 when shift minutes ARE present
technician_utilization._over_100_rule: Logged minutes > shift minutes stores the actual ratio with degraded=true and reason=DATA_QUALITY_OVERLAP

dataset_A._description: Three technicians for one ISO week — team rollup verification

TEAM_ROLLUP._note: Mean of rates coincidentally equals weighted rollup here; P2 in complianceDataset_A shows where they diverge

first_time_fix._formula: matured_rate = first_time_fix_count / total_matured_closures; provisional excluded from matured rate
first_time_fix._repeat_rule: Two closures on same (asset_id, fault_key) within STRICTLY LESS THAN 30 days are linked. At exactly 30 days: NOT linked (outside window). At 29 days: linked.
first_time_fix._maturity_rule: closed_at + 30 days = matured_at; promotion is exactly on-or-after matured_at (inclusive)

dataset_A._description: 8 matured FTF + 2 provisional (closed <30 days ago) + 1 repeat pair
dataset_A._assertion: provisional rows must NOT appear in matured rate denominator

cohort_maturity_clock._description: Work order closed at T; matured_at = T + 30 days

zero_denominator._description: No matured closures in cohort — returns null rate, not 0%

csat_satisfaction._formula: mean_score = AVG(score) over rolling 90 days, 1–5 scale. NPS = promoters% - detractors% where promoters = score 9–10, detractors = score 0–6 (using nps_score column).
csat_satisfaction._late_survey_rule: A survey submitted after the reporting window closes (submitted_at > window_end) must NOT alter a published snapshot

self_service_adoption._attribution_rule: Origin is captured at work order creation and is immutable. A front-office-created request on behalf of a customer must NOT be counted as self-service.

front_office_on_behalf_excluded._assertion: FRONT_OFFICE origin is NOT portal self-service even when created for a customer account
